description:
Automatic Windows HDR Switching For Any Application.

PyAutoActions automates HDR management for your games and applications, enabling and disabling HDR based on the process status.
Changes:
- Added enable bluetooth at game start and disable upon exit under File menu (for bluetooth controllers).
- Added disable mouse globally toggle at game start and disable upon exit under File menu
- (pressing win key will unblock the mouse to block again restart the game).
- Updated libraries.
- Updated Python to v3.14.7
